description: Summarize the most common requirements across three CX listings

input.task: Summarize the most common requirements across these three listings and note which skills appear most frequently.

expected_facts: Salesforce appears in all three listings
SQL is a common requirement across multiple listings
Medallia appears in two of the listings
stakeholder management is a recurring requirement
must_not_hallucinate: the number of employees at each company
specific salary figures for these roles
the founding dates of the companies

description: Compare candidate skills to listing requirements and identify gaps

input.task: Compare the candidate's skills to the requirements in these listings. Identify which requirements the candidate covers and which are gaps.

expected_facts: the candidate has Salesforce experience that matches a listing requirement
Gainsight is in the candidate profile and is required by both listings
the candidate's SQL and Looker skills match listing requirements
the candidate covers most of the required skills with few gaps
must_not_hallucinate: the candidate's exact years of experience
professional certifications held by the candidate

description: Compare two roles for the candidate and note the trade-offs

input.task: Compare these two roles for the candidate and note the key trade-offs between them.

expected_facts: the Director role is more senior than the Manager role
the Director role offers higher compensation
the Manager role is fully remote while the Director role is hybrid
both roles are at SaaS companies and require Salesforce
must_not_hallucinate: the total headcount of either company
the interview process for either role
benefits packages not stated in the listings
